meta.title: Privacy policy — Valadares Global Tech
meta.description: How Valadares Global Tech LLC collects, uses, and protects your information.

privacy.intro: Valadares Global Tech LLC (hereinafter, "VGT", "we", or "the company"), with its website at www.valadaresglobaltech.com, is the controller of the personal data collected through this site. This Privacy Policy describes what data we collect, for what purpose, how we retain it, and what your rights are as a data subject.

sections.heading: 1. Data we collect
paragraphs: We collect the data you voluntarily provide to us through the forms available on the site and, automatically, usage data as you browse:
list: Contact form: name, email address, company, and message.
Quote form: name, company, email address, phone number, country, and description of needs.
Newsletter subscription: email address and, optionally, name.
Site browsing: usage data collected automatically and on an aggregated basis through Google Analytics (pages visited, visit duration, device, and traffic source). See the Cookie Policy for details.
sections.footer: We do not knowingly collect data from anyone under 18 years of age. If you are a minor, do not use the forms on this site without the consent of your legal guardian.

sections.heading: 2. Purpose of processing
paragraphs: The data collected is used exclusively for the following purposes:
list: Handling and responding to contact requests, inquiries, or quote requests.
Sending commercial or informational communications about VGT's services where you have given your explicit consent (newsletter).
Improving the browsing experience and the operation of the website.
Complying with legal obligations applicable to the company.

sections.heading: 3. Legal basis for processing
paragraphs: The processing of your data relies on the following legal bases: (a) your explicit consent when completing a form or subscribing to the newsletter; (b) VGT's legitimate interest in managing the requests it receives; (c) the performance of contractual obligations where applicable.
You may withdraw your consent at any time without affecting the lawfulness of the processing carried out before that withdrawal.

sections.heading: 4. Data retention
paragraphs: Data is retained only as long as strictly necessary to fulfill the purpose for which it was collected. Once the business relationship ends or the applicable limitation period for liability under U.S. law has elapsed, the data will be deleted or anonymized.
Newsletter subscriber data is retained until the subscriber requests to unsubscribe from the service.

sections.heading: 5. Third parties and service providers
paragraphs: VGT may share your data with third parties only where necessary to deliver the service, under confidentiality agreements and in accordance with applicable law:
list: Hosting and technology infrastructure providers that host the website.
Email delivery platforms used to manage the newsletter and respond to inquiries.
External technology providers that back some of our services, when a request relates to them, solely to the extent necessary to handle your request.
Google Analytics (Google LLC), which processes site usage data on an aggregated basis to produce traffic statistics.
sections.footer: VGT does not sell, rent, or transfer your personal data to third parties for their own advertising or commercial purposes.

sections.heading: 6. Your rights as a data subject
paragraphs: As a data subject, you have the right to:
list: Access the personal data we hold about you.
Rectify inaccurate or incomplete data.
Request the deletion of your data when it is no longer necessary for the original purpose.
Object to the processing or request its restriction in the cases permitted by applicable law.
Withdraw your consent at any time for processing based on that legal basis.
sections.footer: To exercise these rights, send your request to info@valadaresglobaltech.com, stating your full name and the action you wish to take. We will handle your request within a reasonable period in accordance with applicable regulations.

sections.heading: 7. Data controller and contact
paragraphs: Controller: Valadares Global Tech LLC
Website: www.valadaresglobaltech.com
Email: info@valadaresglobaltech.com
For any questions regarding this Privacy Policy or the processing of your data, write to us at the address above.

meta.title: Cookie policy — Valadares Global Tech
meta.description: Information about the use of cookies on the Valadares Global Tech LLC website.

cookies.intro: This website, operated by Valadares Global Tech LLC ("VGT"), uses first-party and third-party cookies to ensure the platform works properly and to measure, on an aggregated basis, how the site is used. By browsing this site you accept the use of cookies and the analytics described in this policy. This policy explains what cookies are, which types we use, and how you can manage them.

sections.heading: 1. What are cookies?
paragraphs: Cookies are small text files that websites store on your device (computer, mobile phone, or tablet) when you visit them. They make it possible to remember your preferences, facilitate navigation and, in some cases, analyze user behavior on an aggregated basis.
Cookies do not contain information that directly identifies you as a person, although in combination with other data they may be associated with you as a user.

sections.heading: 2. Types of cookies we use
paragraphs: This site currently uses the following categories of cookies:

items.name: Technical cookies (essential)
items.description: These are necessary for the basic operation of the site: session management, navigation between pages, and display preferences such as light/dark mode. They do not require consent because they are essential to deliver the service you request.

items.name: Analytics cookies
items.description: We use Google Analytics 4 (Google LLC) to understand, on an aggregated basis, how users interact with the site: pages visited, time on site, device type, and traffic source. These cookies are set as you browse the site; you can disable them at any time from your browser settings (see section 4).

sections.heading: 3. Third-party cookies
paragraphs: The site includes third-party cookies from Google Analytics, a web analytics service provided by Google LLC. The information they generate is processed on an aggregated basis in accordance with Google's privacy policy (https://policies.google.com/privacy). We do not use advertising or commercial tracking cookies.

sections.heading: 4. Managing and disabling cookies
paragraphs: You can manage or disable cookies directly from your browser settings. Here is where to find them in the most common browsers:
list: Google Chrome: Settings → Privacy and security → Cookies and other site data.
Mozilla Firefox: Options → Privacy & Security → Cookies and Site Data.
Safari: Preferences → Privacy → Manage Website Data.
Microsoft Edge: Settings → Cookies and site permissions.
sections.footer: Please note that disabling technical cookies may affect the proper functioning of the site. Analytics cookies are optional, and disabling them does not prevent you from using the site. By continuing to browse without disabling them, you accept their use. For any questions about our use of cookies, write to us at info@valadaresglobaltech.com.
